name: EEG-driven GAN thought visualization art project

mentions.name: EEG-driven GAN thought visualization art project
mentions.description: This art project uses a Muse EEG headset to read brain activity and drives the output of a GAN with it, with the goal of visualizing or decoding thoughts. It is currently limited by compute and hardware, and the builder is seeking collaborators, co-founders, and opportunities in the AI + neuroscience + creativity space.
mentions.source_excerpt: Using a Muse EEG headset to read brain activity and use that to drive the output of a GAN. Similar to other projects that try to visualise or decode thoughts, but at the moment it's an art project.
